# Guilherme Rodrigues — Digital Transformation & Experience Design

> Guilherme Rodrigues (Guil) is a digital transformation leader and experience designer with 20+ years of experience, currently Senior VP of Digital Experiences & Platforms at the Public Investment Fund (PIF) in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

## About

Guilherme Rodrigues is a Brazilian designer and digital leader based in Riyadh, KSA. He moved to Dubai in 2012 and has worked across Brazil, the UAE and Saudi Arabia. He leads digital platforms and experiences at PIF, Saudi Arabia's sovereign wealth fund. His specialty is turning ambitious visions into market-ready products that deliver measurable results, using design thinking, generative AI and data-driven insight.

## Career

- Public Investment Fund (Riyadh, KSA): Senior VP, Digital Experiences & Platforms, 2022–present
- First Abu Dhabi Bank (Abu Dhabi, UAE): AVP, Customer Experience & Design, 2018–2022
- Etisalat (Dubai, UAE): Manager, User Experience & Operations, 2016–2018
- EOV Media (Dubai, UAE): Partner & Head of UX Design, 2014–2016
- emaratech (Dubai, UAE): Lead User Experience, 2012–2014
- Hewlett Packard (Porto Alegre, Brazil): Software Designer, 2011
- TOTVS (Porto Alegre, Brazil): User Interface Specialist, 2009–2010
- ConceitoWeb (Porto Alegre, Brazil): System Analyst & Operations Manager, 2006–2009

## Key Projects

- payit Wallet (First Abu Dhabi Bank): the UAE's first fully-featured digital wallet; app rating raised from 3.5 to 4.5 in 30 days. https://www.payit.ae
- Unimed Brasil: end-to-end experience for Brazil's biggest healthcare cooperative; featured on the App Store and Google Play in 2019. https://www.unimed.coop.br/site/
- Dubai Smart Gate (emaratech × Dubai Airports): second-generation smart gate design; the foundation for the gates in operation at DXB today.
- Gas Station, Re-imagined (Etisalat Digital): strategy concept exploring new revenue streams and digital touchpoints.
- Etisalat Design Studio: led a 42-person multidisciplinary studio; shipped the Smiles loyalty app (~1.2M users, 4.6★ App Store) and the etisalat.ae digital transformation program.
- CoreCase: digitised, eco-friendly core boxes for mining; end-to-end flow from field to back-office.
